questions.question: For the four-sentence (S1 to S4) paragraph below, sentences S1 and S4 are given. From the options P, Q, R and S select the appropriate sentences for S2 and S3, respectively . S1: The Centre has unveiled broader benefits for its employees in the new guaranteed pension scheme. S2: ……………………………………… S3 : ……………………………………… S4: Those covered under the current National Pension System will have a chance to shift to the UPS. P: The Centre claims the UPS, to be implemented from April next year, will benefit 23 lakh employees. Q: The minimum eligibility period for receipt of pension is 10 years. R: The Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is surely a political response to the growing nationwide demand to revert to the pre-2004 Old Pension Scheme (OPS) S: Like pension, family pension is also payable upto and including for the day of death of the recipient.
questions.questionHtml:
For the four-sentence (S1 to S4) paragraph below, sentences S1 and S4 are given. From the options P, Q, R and S select the appropriate sentences for S2 and S3, respectively.

S1: The Centre has unveiled broader benefits for its employees in the new guaranteed pension scheme.

S2: ………………………………………

S3: ………………………………………

S4: Those covered under the current National Pension System will have a chance to shift to the UPS.

P: The Centre claims the UPS, to be implemented from April next year, will benefit 23 lakh employees.

Q: The minimum eligibility period for receipt of pension is 10 years.

R: The Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is surely a political response to the growing nationwide demand to revert to the pre-2004 Old Pension Scheme (OPS)

S: Like pension, family pension is also payable upto and including for the day of death of the recipient.
questions.solution: S1 introduces the Centre's unveiling of broader benefits in a new guaranteed pension scheme, implying the introduction of a specific scheme.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant (A) / in the Atchutapuram Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Anakapalli district, (B) / Andhra Pradesh, are the worst industrial accident (C) / in the region in recent times. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant (A) / in the Atchutapuram Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Anakapalli district, (B) / Andhra Pradesh, are the worst industrial accident (C) / in the region in recent times. (D)
questions.solution: 'is' will be used instead of 'are' because the subject 'The blast' is singular, so the verb should also be singular; Like— The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant is the worst industrial accident in the region in recent times.

questions.solution: B) The correct spelling of ‘Dumbell’ is ‘Dumbbell,’ which means "a short bar with a weight at each end, used typically in pairs for exercise or muscle-building."

questions.question: Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks . The investigators launched a __________ to uncover how the company exploited a legal __________ to avoid paying taxes
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.

The investigators launched a __________ to uncover how the company exploited a legal __________ to avoid paying taxes
questions.solution: 'Probe' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "probe" का अर्थ होता है किसी घटना या मामले की गहन जांच करना। और 'loophole' का अर्थ है किसी नियम या कानून में छूट या खामी का फायदा उठाना, जिससे करों के भुगतान से बचा जा सके। जबकि 'Plug' का अर्थ छेद को भरना, 'Mitigation' का अर्थ कम करना, 'Monitor' का अर्थ निगरानी करना, 'Urgency' का अर्थ आपातकालीन स्थिति, 'Imperative' का अर्थ अनिवार्यता, और 'Temper' का अर्थ क्रोध या स्वभाव से है, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . The case of acute flaccid paralysis, (A)/ likely due to polio, in an child from Tikrikilla in Meghalaya, (B)/ and in the media spotlight, was reported by (C)/ the State government on August 14. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The case of acute flaccid paralysis, (A)/ likely due to polio, in an child from Tikrikilla in Meghalaya, (B)/ and in the media spotlight, was reported by (C)/ the State government on August 14. (D)
questions.solution: 'a child' will be used instead of 'an child' because 'child' begins with a consonant sound (ch), and the article 'a' is used before words that start with consonant sounds. Like— She is a child who loves to play.

questions.questionHtml:

Under the glow of fluorescent lights, the liaison arranged a leisure trip for her neice to help her relax after a busy work week.
questions.solution: D) The correct spelling of ‘Neice’ is ‘Niece,’ which means "a daughter of one's brother or sister or of one's brother-in-law or sister-in-law." इसे हिंदी में "भतीजी या भांजी" कहा जाता है।

questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Haryana, which is among the leading milk producers nationwide, (A) fared even worse as 28 per cent of the samples did not (B) passed the quality test. With the festival season (C) coming up, the searches and seizures will be intensified. (D)
questions.solution: 'did not pass' will be used instead of 'did not passed' because after 'did,' the base form of the verb is always used, not the Past Tense; Like— 28 per cent of the samples did not pass the quality test.

questions.question: Comprehension: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank. From the moment of birth, every human being wants happiness and does not want suffering. Neither social conditioning nor education _____1____ ideology affect this. From the very core of our being, we simply desire ______2_____. I don’t know whether the universe, with its countless galaxies, stars and planets, _____3_____a deeper meaning or not, but at the very least, it is clear that we humans who live on this earth face the task of making a happy life for ourselves. Therefore, it is important to discover what will bring about the greatest degree of happiness. Every kind of happiness and suffering is either mental or physical. Of the two, it is the mind that ______4_____the greatest influence on most of us. Unless we are either gravely ill or _____5_____ basic necessities, our physical condition plays a secondary role in life. If the body is content, we virtually ignore it. The mind, however, registers every event, no matter how small. Hence we should devote our most serious efforts to bringing about mental peace. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence. He passed away in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the following sentence.

He passed away in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July.

options.text: in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July
options.html: in the year 1950 at 10 a.m. on 13 July

options.text: on 13 July at 10 a.m. in the year 1950
options.html: on 13 July at 10 a.m. in the year 1950

options.text: at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950
options.html: at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950

options.text: in the year 1950 on 13 July at 10 a.m.
options.html: in the year 1950 on 13 July at 10 a.m.

questions.solution: C) 'at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि समय की क्रमबद्धता के अनुसार, सबसे पहले समय (10 a.m.), फिर दिनांक (13 July), और फिर वर्ष (1950) का उल्लेख किया जाना चाहिए; जैसे— "The event occurred at 10 a.m. on 13 July in the year 1950."
